title: Make package usable by consumers: ship manifest, metadata, types, release as 0.3.0
description: npm 0.2.0 omits custom-elements.json because it is not in package.json files. Manifest paths point at unshipped src/. Package has no repository/homepage. 0.2.0 is already published, so the fix needs a new version.
notes: Code is in PR #19 with CI green. Remaining: merge, npm publish 0.3.0, set the changelog date, tag v0.3.0.
close_reason: Published 0.3.0 to npm from ea07d15. Manifest verified on unpkg and jsDelivr; tagged v0.3.0.

title: Sync 'trigger' attribute into custom-elements.json manifest
description: custom-elements.json was out of date: the 'trigger' attribute already exists in source (src/border-wc.js, src/effects/draw.js), tests (test/draw.spec.js), and docs (docs/api.html, docs/playground.js), but was missing from the manifest. This adds it (3-line diff). Not a new feature — a manifest catch-up. trigger controls the draw effect's reveal: 'time' (default, one-shot) or 'scroll' (animation-timeline: view(), degrades when unsupported).
close_reason: Regenerated custom-elements.json via cem analyze; trigger entry matches source. Committed on chore/cem-sync-trigger.

title: washi is nearly invisible on dark backgrounds
description: Strips use mix-blend-mode: multiply, which goes to near black on a dark surface. Visible in the dark gallery. test/washi.spec.js asserts multiply, so the blend is intentional and a fix needs a design decision, for example a different blend or a custom property to choose it. Package change, so it needs a release.
close_reason: Added --washi-blend (default multiply, live via var()); gallery sets normal in dark. Ships in 0.3.1.
